firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg / 390-first.jpg: h1 'Huntsville house cleaning, priced line by line' (7 words, trade+city+value); one primary sienna 'Price it' + quieter 'Call'; phone in header (1440) and sticky bar (390); proof line under h1 with sample rating; receipt strip visible at hero bottom with torn edge; next band peeks. Held below 10: hero photo is placeholder gray block so marquee strip not visually delivered.

distinctiveness.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Running Receipt signature in ≥4 sections (hero header line, quote builder live tally, checklist explorer lines, reviews as receipt notes, footer total). Bricolage Grotesque display carries thermal-paper texture; DM Mono for prices makes receipt feel printed; sienna/paper palette avoids yellow-glove cliché. Held below 9: placeholder photos mean identity carried by type and receipt rule only; section shapes fairly conventional.

type.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Bricolage Grotesque (display) + Figtree (body) + DM Mono (accent) concept-driven trio; fluid clamp scale; tabular-nums on prices and receipt lines; tracked-caps kickers; text-wrap balance/pretty. Mono accent is receipt voice made visible. Body >=16px, no orphans.

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: real container grid, alternating tones paper->mid->paper->accent->paper->deep->paper->deep, varied shapes. Deduction -1.0: three t-deep bands touch at ~65-90% scroll (#reviews -> #area -> #contact) reading as one long undifferentiated dark block; accent tool band floats without enough contrast against surrounding paper sections.

photo.notes: 1440-first.jpg hero, 1440-full.jpg story/checklist, 390-full.jpg: every frame is placeholder/broken fallback (alt='Placeholder for...'). Frame CSS exists but invisible with no real image. Placeholder media expected per task (not mustFix). Floor 6; sits at floor because nothing to assess.

copy.notes: 1440-full.jpg: concrete trade nouns (baseboards, grout, oven add-on, pet hair visit, move-out PCS); every price/review carries visible Sample tag; honest form success state ('This is a demo site - nothing was sent'); action-named buttons (Price it / Send request); voice matches receipt thesis; no banned words; footer disclaimer present.

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg / 390-full.jpg: composed-for-phone layout; h1 wraps cleanly; both actions above fold; sticky Call + Price-it bar pinned at bottom; receipt lines stack; form fields full-width; no horizontal scroll; tap targets >=48px. 1024-first.jpg holds layout without breaking.

a11y.notes: dist/index.html: skip-link present; :focus-visible outline defined; every input has real <label for>; reduced-motion safety net reveals everything; forced-colors borders on controls; honeypot aria-hidden; single h1 with h2 per section; lang=en; noindex set. render.json zero console errors.

motion.notes: dist/index.html + kit CSS: clip-path wipe on receipt lines driven by --sw-p, SplitText reveals, Lenis smooth scroll, staggered reveals, press-scale on buttons. Reduced-motion fully respected. Capped below 9: static screenshots cannot confirm easing/timing quality or that receipt line wipe animates on interaction.

wow.notes: 1440-full.jpg: page-as-receipt idea plus quote builder tool tied to thesis. Held below 8: quote builder reads as flat mid-tone block with inputs but no visible live receipt output in still; tool interactive result not visually compelling from screenshot.

polish.notes: dist/index.html head: SVG favicon + apple-touch-icon, OG meta (plain color due to placeholder), JSON-LD @type HomeAndConstructionBusiness with areaServed + openingHours, theme-color, lazy images with explicit dimensions, forced-colors handling, preloaded display font. Consistent radius system, one rule weight, one accent. Footer is designed receipt close.

elevate.move: Art-direct frames as sequence: hero = clean kitchen daylight, checklist tabs = process shots (oven, shower glass, mop, duster), story = detail shots (sink shine, vacuum lines, made bed), area = Huntsville suburban house. Apply saturate(.85)/contrast(1.05)/sepia(.08) grade uniformly. Tie at least one frame to signature with clip-reveal driven by --sw-p wipe.

Re-tone lower half: paper hero -> mid quote-builder -> paper services -> paper checklist -> break photo -> paper story -> deep reviews -> PAPER area -> deep contact -> deep footer. Let receipt rule run continuously across tonal breaks so rule, not background, is through-line.
